claims.statement: Retain the exact support-core polynomial and rooted branch recurrences for ordinary trees of order at least three, with every original leaf tag counted, and retain the strict-negative aggregate theorem for every eligible ordinary star.
claims.scope: The star theorem applies to all finite ordinary stars and eligible p satisfying x+2<=p and 3p<2m+1. The exact decorated-core formulas apply to finite ordinary trees of order at least three. Neither establishes the primary aggregate's sign on general branching cores.
claims.reason: retained: direct coefficient and binomial-ratio checks establish the star theorem; splitting independent sets by selected core roots establishes each polynomial identity and shows the support multiplicity m_s is preserved. The source correctly identifies the missing selector-to-local-sum sign comparison, so this disposition does not extend to the registered primary target.

limitations: This review retains only the star subfamily theorem and exact evaluation formulas; it does not resolve the primary aggregate on general trees.
The T_22 and T_60 control values were accepted from the common handoff and were not independently recomputed in this review.
No exhaustive search, source-script replay, or external literature search was performed.
